Exact flight-number joins were recomputed locally from pinned August VRA bytes (27,597,831 bytes, SHA-256 a993dab4f8e192a473c998f7fe17703de489aaa359a4b6eb45631f68d99081d1): REALIZADO rows with valid actual departure/arrival timestamps in August, raw GLO operator, exact flight number and exact ICAO origin/destination. For each selected number all matched rows use the stated pair and no other pair occurs that month. This is historical actual movement evidence; passenger/cargo and VRA nonstop semantics remain unknown and it does not establish Oct 3 operation.

Exact flight-number stage records come from the pinned SIROS snapshot dated Oct 2, 2026 (27,842,178 bytes; SHA-256 2bc37f1f1098f2f87d830662c953f0443067dad168f334719c466221318941c1). Selected rows are registered regular passenger plans whose Oct 3 validity/weekday matches and whose raw operator maps GLO→G3. SIROS CSV has no explicit nonstop flag; stage numbers are ordinal, not a total-stage count. This is planned registration evidence, not actual Oct 3 operation, confirmed flight number or RTW eligibility. Public redistribution remains notice-review.

Official RIOgaleão GOL-filtered structured board snapshot observed 2026-10-03 17:45–17:48 UTC, locally retained as docs/coverage-ledger/siros-brazil-three-carrier-20261003/riogaleao_gol_board_2026-10-03.json (136 rows, SHA-256 abe8f420cc927ef5841be1ec21cdfbb0f4cb6dc26e6e7c96c850155701d2c04d). Date-specific registered planned passenger stage rows from the pinned Oct 2 SIROS snapshot (27,842,178 bytes, SHA-256 2bc37f1f1098f2f87d830662c953f0443067dad168f334719c466221318941c1), captured 2026-10-02T14:23:47.646507Z.
